name: ComfyUI · Wan 2.2 14B + LightX2V (quality)
licence_note: Wan2.2-T2V-A14B high/low-noise experts (Wan-AI, fp8_scaled repackage by Comfy-Org), the LightX2V Wan2.2-Lightning 4-step LoRA v1.1 (lightx2v), UMT5-XXL and the Wan2.1 VAE: all Apache-2.0.
notes: Two 14B experts in fp8 with the 4-step LightX2V distillation LoRA: KSamplerAdvanced high noise (steps 0-2) then low noise (steps 2-4), cfg 1, euler. 16 fps. Steps are not mapped (the 2-stage split is part of the graph). Core nodes only. The negative prompt is Wan's own default (Chinese); a Studio job only replaces it when you type one.
estimate_note: Measured on the RTX 5070 Ti (16 GB) with ComfyUI v0.45.3, cold models, nothing else on the GPU; vram_gb = peak VRAM of the ComfyUI process (dynamic VRAM uses what is free).
